title: Phase — Execute (compact)
description: Two steps: TDD implementation with fetch_knowhow per domain slice, then two-layer review. Optional tidy/refactor is not a separate manifest step (can be done inside the same pass).

steps.title: Implement per PLAN (TDD)
steps.notes: Per domain slice: fetch_knowhow(domain) before code in that slice, then Red–Green–Refactor; small commits. If PLAN.md defines non-unit verification, follow PLAN. Next step: two-layer review.

steps.title: Review slice (two-layer)
steps.notes: Layer 1 = plan / AC compliance; Layer 2 = quality. Skip extra passes for trivial edits.
